SEVERITY RATING:

1 = Minor (First aid, minor disruption)

2 = Moderate (Medical treatment, temporary impact)

3 = Serious (Lost time injury, significant impact)

4 = Major (Permanent disability, major disruption)

5 = Catastrophic (Fatality, business closure)

PROBABILITY RATING:

1 = Rare (Unlikely to occur)

2 = Unlikely (Possible but not expected)

3 = Possible (May occur occasionally)

4 = Likely (Will occur under normal conditions)

5 = Almost Certain (Frequent occurrence)

RISK LEVELS:

1-4 = LOW - Acceptable, maintain controls

5-9 = MEDIUM - Manageable, require monitoring

10-15 = HIGH - Significant, urgent action required

16-25 = CRITICAL - Unacceptable, stop work until controls implemented
